title: AI Engineer Tools & Automations

title: GenAI Engineer
description: Role DescriptionWe are looking for an AI Engineer focused on Generative AI, with the aim of transforming complex workflows and data into intelligent, automated solutions that drive our business operations. In this role, you will design, implement, and orchestrate advanced LLMs and autonomous agents to guide strategic decisions, enhance customer experiences, and solve challenging business problems, partnering closely with cross-functional teams.Main ResponsibilitiesDesign and Implement AI Solutions: Develop and deploy Generative AI models, autonomous agents, and conversational interfaces to address complex business challenges and automate internal workflows.Model Optimization: Fine-tune existing foundation models and build robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure highly accurate, context-aware AI outputs.Prompt Engineering & Orchestration: Craft and optimize prompts and utilize orchestration frameworks to build multi-agent systems that handle complex, multi-step tasks.Business Alignment: Partner with domain experts to translate ambiguous business questions and operational bottlenecks into actionable GenAI frameworks.Production & LLMOps: Partner with the MLOps/DevOps teams to ensure seamless model deployment, monitor for latency, quality, and hallucinations, and adhere to CI/CD and automated testing best practices.Experimentation: Design and analyze rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments to validate the efficacy and user adoption of new AI-driven features.Stakeholder Communication: Communicate AI concepts, system capabilities, and limitations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Integration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, product managers, and data scientists, to integrate your AI agents and models into production systems.Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the rapidly evolving advancements in the Generative AI, LLM, and NLP landscape.Requirements:Agentic AI Expertise: Solid, proven track record in agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and advanced prompt engineering.System Integration: Clear understanding of how to connect LLMs to execution layers (RPA robots, webhooks, REST APIs) to drive automated actions in enterprise systems.Business-Facing Mindset: Strong curiosity and willingness to immerse themselves in operational business realities to co-design effective solutions.Pragmatism & Speed: A test-and-learn attitude geared toward fast prototyping, evaluation, and iterative delivery.Language Requirement: Native or full professional proficiency in Italian, which is essential for handling Italian-language documentation, local process nuances, and direct collaboration with SMEs.This engineer will serve as the core technical engine of a dedicated, cross-functional team, with direct visibility and a measurable impact on the company's P&L. title: Partner Solutions Architect , AI Builder
description: About Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. Supabase is the backend of choice for a growing wave of AI-native builders, and we're deepening structured partnerships with the platforms they build on top of — Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. These partners' teams are talking to thousands of developers and agents who need exactly what we build—a full backend platform with Postgres at the core—without the vendor lock-in. This is an opportunity to get Supabase in front of the right partner SAs and make us the default recommendation for a modern, AI-ready backend. About the Role We’re looking for a Platform Solutions Architect to join our Success Team and help embed Supabase into the Solutions and Engineering communities with AI Builders. You’ll work closely with Partner Solutions Architects and Partner Engineers at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable , helping us proactively identify builder problems where Supabase is the right solution and closing the gap between partner intent and real developer outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions of AI-native apps and agents. What You’ll Be Responsible For In this role, you’ll focus on three core pillars: Technical Evangelism & Education Build deep relationships with Technical counterparts at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, focusing initially on defined use cases and agent/app-migration motions. Develop and deliver technical workshops, training materials, and enablement content to give partner SAs the fluency to position Supabase. Create demos, integration guides, and reference architectures that make Supabase’s fit with Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable immediately legible. Partner with SAs at these companies on active opportunities to move deals forward and feeding technical pipeline intelligence back to the alliance lead. Technical Support & Enablement Resolve blockers for partner SAs working on Supabase implementations to maintain their credibility with the builders they support. Troubleshoot complex integration scenarios and turn solutions into reusable assets. Maintain a close feedback loop with Supabase product and engineering teams to ensure technical guidance reflects the latest platform capabilities. Measure success through co-sell opportunities sourced, influenced deals, and SA enablement metrics across the Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable partnerships. Content Creation & Thought Leadership Write technical blog posts and case studies that demonstrate real-world Supabase implementations built on Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. Represent Supabase at conferences, meetups, and partner-sponsored events (e.g. Anthropic and OpenAI dev days, Vercel Ship, Lovable community events). Develop video content and interactive learning experiences to reduce the "time-to-fluency" for partner SAs. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 5+ years of experience in technical roles with deep hands-on experience building on modern AI infrastructure. Previous experience working at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, Lovable (or a similar AI builder platform) or as a partner to one is required. Understand how partner SAs at AI builder platforms are incentivized, how they make recommendations, and how the partner ecosystem influences developer decisions. Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, explaining complex concepts with ease. Have a strong technical foundation in PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern development frameworks like React and Next.js, plus fluency with AI/agent tooling (LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks). Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly to build a playbook from scratch. Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers building the next generation of AI-native products. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
